description: IOC enrichment with ICS/OT campaign context. Pass ?value=1.2.3.4&type=ip (or type=domain). Queries AlienVault OTX (reputation, pulse count, OT-tagged feeds) + AbuseIPDB (abuse confidence score, ISP, Tor node detection) + DeepSeek CTI analysis for known ICS threat actor association and campaign context.
